t: You're looking at the monument to William and Catherine Blake, in Bunhill Fields. It shows the two of them together. William Blake was a poet, painter and printmaker, largely unrecognised in his lifetime, who is now seen as a central figure of Romantic poetry and art. He lived in London all his life apart from three years in Felpham. Catherine, his wife, was a vital presence and assistant throughout his life, so it is fitting that she shares the memorial.
